discovery: Prediction and discovery of baryon acoustic oscillations as a standard ruler for the cosmic expansion history

nominees.name: Daniel J. Eisenstein
nominees.affiliation: Harvard University, Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian, USA

nominees.name: Rashid Sunyaev
nominees.affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Astrophysics, Garching, Germany

motivation: Sound waves in the primordial photon-baryon plasma, predicted by Sunyaev (with the late Zel'dovich), froze into the matter distribution at a fixed comoving scale. In 2005 Eisenstein, using SDSS luminous red galaxies, and Cole, with the 2dF Galaxy Redshift Survey, independently detected this baryon acoustic feature in galaxy clustering. They established a geometric standard ruler, calibrated by the cosmic microwave background and largely immune to astrophysical systematics. BAO independently confirmed cosmic acceleration and became the backbone of dark energy programmes from BOSS to DESI. The recent DESI results hint that dark energy may evolve with time. This is a precise, independent cross-check of the expansion history, and it exposes possible cracks in LambdaCDM. It has turned the universe itself into a laboratory for fundamental physics.
